behavior_constraints: The raw `overall_status` field in the verification report must always reflect the strict v1 verification result (e.g., 'FAIL' for non-deterministic output) and must NOT be modified by policy rules.
Only the exit code and the `policy_evaluation` section of the report may be affected by policy evaluation.
The diff subcommand must exit with code 1 whenever `summary.regressions >= 1`.
A new `repro-verify summary <report1.json> [report2.json ...]` subcommand must read one or more verification report files.
Summary JSON output (default) must contain a `reports` array with one entry per input file.
Each summary report entry must include: file, manifest_name, manifest_version, overall_status, step_count, pass_count, fail_count, pass_rate.
Summary JSON output must contain an `aggregate` object including: total_reports, total_steps, total_pass, total_fail, overall_pass_rate, all_passing.
Summary subcommand supports `--format json` (default) and `--format text`.
Summary text output: one line per report as `<name>@<version>  <status>  <pass>/<total> steps  (<pct>%)`, then a `---` separator, then an aggregate line.
Summary exit code 0 only when every report has overall_status == 'PASS'.
affected_prior: diffCmd and diff summary regressions handling (round 2)
entities.summary: This round fixes the policy engine to stop mutating the raw overall_status, fixes the diff subcommand exit code on regressions, and adds a new `repro-verify summary` subcommand that aggregates verification report statistics in JSON or text form.
